To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

Wnt9B expression in Six2-positive progenitor cells results in severe renal cystic disease and gastrointestinal distress in adult mice, and that this phenotype can be rescued by expression of stabilized β-catenine in Six2-positive renal progenitors.
conditional expression of Wnt signaling in Six2-positive progenitor cells causes severe kidney and gastrointestinal tract abnormalities in mice.
expression of WNT9B in SIX2-expressing kidney mesenchyme causes severe renal failure and a transformation of gastric epithelial cells to intestinal fate.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of the kidney, and how it is regulated by the Wnt signaling pathway.
how cells in the kidney respond to signals that promote their fate and how these signals can be manipulated to alter cell differentiation decisions.
understanding the mechanisms that control the formation of the kidney.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
Wnt9 is a canonical Wnt ligant and is capable of rescuing kidney defects in mice.
Wnt9 is capable of inducing differentiation in the kidney but that its ectopic expression in Six2-positive progenitors is capable of disrupting the development of multiple organ systems.
the expression of a canonical Wnt ligands in Six2-positive progenitor cells disrupts kidney and stomach function.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the expression of a canonical Wnt ligands in Six2-expressed cells disrupts kidney and gastrointestinal development.

the canonical Wnt signaling pathway plays an important role in the development and maintenance of the stomach and kidney, and that the timing and location of Wnt signaling is crucial for normal development.
the canonical Wnt9b signal is required for normal kidney and gastric development and that the Wnt9B signal is not required in Six2-expressor cells.
The main takeaway from our work is that
Wnt9a is required to maintain the progenitor pool, while Wnt9b promotes nephron differentiation.
Wnt9a and Wnt9b can have opposing roles in kidney development.
Wnt9B expression in Six2 positive cells is detrimental to the developing kidney and gastrointestinal tract.
